name: AI Job Application Tracker & Alert System

parameters.content:
## AI Job Application Tracker & Alert System

Runs headlessly every 3h via GitHub Actions (`n8n execute --file=workflows/workflow.json`).

1. Fetch jobs (Adzuna + Greenhouse boards)
2. Normalize + merge sources
3. Dedupe against data/jobs.json
4. Score new jobs with Groq LLM against my resume
5. Save results back to data/jobs.json
6. Open a GitHub Issue for any match scoring >= 75

Edit search keywords / location / resume text in the **Config** node below.

### Step 1 — Fetch job postings
Adzuna API (Germany, role keywords from Config) + two public Greenhouse company job boards (no auth needed). Results are normalized into a common shape: job_id, title, company, location, url, description, source.

### Step 2 — Dedupe
Reads the committed data/jobs.json (already checked out by the Action) and drops any job whose job_id has already been seen, so we only spend LLM calls on genuinely new postings.

### Step 3 — Score with Groq
Each new job + my resume text is sent to Groq (openai/gpt-oss-120b). The model returns fit_score (0-100), reasoning, and a cover_letter_opener as strict JSON.

### Step 4 — Save + Alert
All scored jobs (old + new) are written back to data/jobs.json, which the Action commits. Any new job with fit_score >= 75 gets a GitHub Issue opened via the GITHUB_TOKEN the Action already has — no extra signup, this is the "alert".
